rawFindings.title: Breaking change in query population option preparation
rawFindings.explanation: The code replaces the call to 'preparePopulationOptions(self, options)' with 'utils.object.vals(self.options.populate)'. This removes the logic for handling 'lean' options during population, which is critical for correct query behavior when using 'lean' options in population.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the use of the 'preparePopulationOptions' function or move its (previously removed) functionality inline to ensure population options are correctly prepared including processing related flags like 'lean'. Removing this function breaks existing features relying on it.
